settings.groups: Last word of signal name: family A or family B
settings.band: 5th to 95th percentiles over 200 independent draws, per history
settings.history: Median pairwise half-L1 distance between exact shares over five seeds
settings.useful: First tested draw count whose worst-history q95 error is below history/3
settings.timing: One solver call per nonempty coalition. Empty coalition is known zero. Fixed gamma requires the full target run as common setup.
settings.sampling: Independent fresh cache per repetition; seeded generators. Cached deterministic table avoids re-running identical expensive histories across repetitions.

notes: Useful-budget recommendations also require zero rank-deficient repeats; deficient draws remain in all error summaries.
Wall backtest timings measured with three histories concurrently; equivalent estimator totals reconstruct queried costs plus replay overhead.
Owen is an exact grouped convention, not an approximation of Shapley.
Empty coalition is known zero and counts as one distinct value but no optimiser backtest.
Only K=4,6,8 measured. Five histories are an exploratory spread comparison, not a confidence interval for population uncertainty.
